paragraphs: By way of introduction, my name is Joshua Chappell. My intent is to apply for the Marketing Director at Tatum Management Group. I feel I have a lot of immediate value I can bring to your organization.

You run performance-driven campaigns across e-commerce brands and media that reach millions. That is where I work best. I hold a Master's in Marketing with a specialization in Marketing Analytics, plus Google's Digital Marketing and E-Commerce certification. At Charter One, I created a video initiative that raised ad click-through rates by over 200% and a social content initiative that drove 20x more engagement than standard content. As owner of Lightbox Digital, I grew the business with Facebook ads and organic outreach, and I helped double enrollment for a large charter school through a content initiative. I set KPIs, track them in dashboards, and let the data guide creative decisions.
I appreciate that you value innovation, collaboration, and mission-driven work; these are all values that I strive to emulate.
Thank you for taking the time out of your busy day to read my letter. I look forward to the opportunity of doing an interview with you.

reference.jd_text:
# Job Description Reference — Marketing Director, The Officer Tatum

## Application Details
- **Company:** Tatum Management Group LLC (The Officer Tatum LLC)
- **Role:** Marketing Director
- **Location:** Scottsdale, AZ — Remote
- **Type:** Full-time
- **Pay:** $75,000 – $100,000 per year + performance bonus up to 20%
- **Posted:** ~11 days before July 18, 2026 (via ZipRecruiter)
- **Benefits:** Health insurance, PTO, holidays, retirement plan, professional development allowance

## Company Info
The Officer Tatum LLC is a fast-growing media and e-commerce company. It runs a portfolio of brands including TatumStore.com, ShinergyLife.com, and PureChoiceApparel.com. The company partners with high-profile influencers and clients on campaigns, events, and content that reach millions of people each month. Its stated mission: combine innovation, performance-driven marketing, and cultural influence to inspire and engage communities nationwide.

## Key Responsibilities
- Develop and oversee multi-channel campaigns (email, paid ads, social, video, influencer collaborations) for TatumStore.com, ShinergyLife.com, PureChoiceApparel.com, and client brands.
- Build and manage a comprehensive email marketing program: segmentation, automation, performance optimization.
- Lead paid advertising across Google Ads, YouTube, Meta, TikTok, and emerging platforms.
- Collaborate with design, content, and video teams on materials for merch drops, interviews, podcasts, and live events.
- Drive brand awareness for The Officer Tatum's media presence (appearances, speaking engagements, partnerships).
- Support marketing strategy and execution for clients and influencers in the network.
- Establish and track KPIs, dashboards, and reporting frameworks.
- Conduct market and audience research.
- Oversee brand consistency across all campaigns.
- Manage external vendors, agencies, and freelancers.

## Qualifications
- 5+ years progressive marketing experience; 3+ years in a leadership role.
- Track record building and scaling campaigns for e-commerce, consumer brands, or digital media.
- Strong paid media expertise (Google Ads, Meta Ads, YouTube, TikTok).
- Success with email platforms (Klaviyo, Mailchimp, or similar).
- Creative campaign development for merch, events, or influencer content.
- Analytics tools: Google Analytics, Meta Business Manager, Looker, etc.
- Strong leadership, communication, and project management.
- Entrepreneurial and comfortable in a fast-paced environment.

## Compensation Notes
- Bonus up to 20% tied to ROI, customer growth, event success, and client satisfaction.
- Professional development allowance for courses, conferences, certifications.

research.overview: The posting is listed under Tatum Management Group LLC. The other copies (Breezy HR, Remotive) name the employer as The Officer Tatum LLC. This is the Scottsdale, AZ media and e-commerce company of Brandon Tatum, a conservative commentator and former Tucson police officer who started his own media company in late 2019. Its businesses include a YouTube channel (about 3.7M subscribers per Wikipedia), a national radio show distributed by Salem Radio Network since May 2022, and online stores (TatumStore.com, ShinergyLife.com, PureChoiceApparel.com). It is a small, founder-led company: LinkedIn lists 11-50 employees and Buzzfile estimates 1 at its listed location, so headcount is unclear. No employee reviews for this company turned up on Glassdoor, Indeed or Reddit. The Glassdoor and Indeed 'Tatum' pages that come up in searches belong to a different company (Tatum, an executive staffing firm owned by Randstad), so their ratings do not apply here. The only outside rating found is a consumer one: a BBB profile for The Officer Tatum Store.

glassdoor.summary: No Glassdoor page for Tatum Management Group or The Officer Tatum LLC was found. The 'Tatum' page that shows up (3.6 stars from 94 reviews) is Tatum, an executive staffing and interim-management firm owned by Randstad. It is a different company and its reviews say nothing about this employer.

indeed.summary: No Indeed employee reviews for this employer were found. The Indeed 'Tatum' and 'Tatum, LLC' review pages belong to the unrelated staffing firm. The Indeed connector failed to connect today, so get_company_data could not be run.

reddit.summary: Searches (including site:reddit.com) returned no Reddit threads about working at The Officer Tatum or Tatum Management Group. Results were only about Brandon Tatum as a public figure.

pros.point: Fully remote, full-time role with a posted pay range of $75k-$100k, a performance bonus of up to 20%, and benefits (medical, PTO, retirement; the saved posting also lists a professional development allowance).

Large existing audience to market to: the founder's YouTube channel has about 3.7M subscribers and he hosts a national radio show distributed by Salem Radio Network. The marketing lead would not be starting from zero.
Several brands in one job (merch store, wellness/apparel e-commerce, media, client and influencer work), which gives broad, varied marketing experience.
Small, founder-led company (LinkedIn lists 11-50 employees). A Marketing Director would likely work directly with the founder and own marketing end to end.
The business has run since late 2019 and has grown from a YouTube channel into radio, books and stores, so it is not a brand-new startup.

cons.point: No employee reviews exist on Glassdoor, Indeed or Reddit, so there is no outside view of management, pay fairness, hours or turnover. The 'Tatum' ratings that show up belong to a different company.

The BBB gives The Officer Tatum Store an F, partly for not responding to 3 complaints. Customer reviews average 2.25/5 and mention unshipped orders and unanswered emails. These are customer complaints, not employee reviews, and the sample is small, but a Marketing Director would inherit that reputation problem.

The brand is tied to a politically polarizing commentator who draws public criticism. YouTube videos also make unconfirmed claims about lawsuits involving him. Some future employers may view the work as partisan.

The team is probably thin: LinkedIn says 11-50 employees but Buzzfile estimates 1 at the listed location. The director may do much of the hands-on work themselves, with little support staff or HR structure.

The role has been posted since early July 2026 and keeps getting re-posted. On 2026-10-14 ZipRecruiter showed a fresh 9-day-old listing, and an earlier copy was marked as re-posted. Open for 3+ months can mean a high bar, a hard-to-fill role, or turnover. Ask why.

The employer name differs between postings: Tatum Management Group LLC on ZipRecruiter and Talent.com, The Officer Tatum LLC on Breezy and Remotive. A search for 'Tatum Management Group LLC' found an unrelated Florida contractor of that name and no Arizona record. Confirm which entity would actually employ and pay him.

Part of the pay depends on performance: the bonus of up to 20% is tied to ROI, customer growth, event success and client satisfaction. One aggregator copy lists only $75,000, so the offer may start at the low end of the range.

red_flags: No employee reviews anywhere, so culture and management cannot be checked from outside.
BBB F rating on the company's store for unanswered complaints (customer-side, small sample).
The Marketing Director listing has been open and re-posted since early July 2026.
Employer name differs between postings (Tatum Management Group LLC vs The Officer Tatum LLC). Confirm the employing entity.
Brand is tied to a politically polarizing public figure, which could affect how future employers read the job.
research.bottom_line: This is a real company with a real, remote, reasonably paid role, and it has a large built-in audience. But there are no employee reviews, so culture is unknown, and the only outside rating is a BBB F on the store side. It is a small, founder-run, politically branded company, and the role has been open since July. If Joshua goes ahead, he should ask in the interview: how big the team is and who he would report to, what the marketing budget is, how the 20% bonus is measured, which legal entity would employ him, and why the role has stayed open since July.
